task_text:
`gh` checks whether each installed extension is official on every startup to decide whether to disable telemetry for it. Currently the check calls `IsOfficial(ext.Name(), ext.Owner())` with two string parameters. For git-installed extensions, `ext.Owner()` spawns git every time. Since official extension names are unique, the check should call `ext.Owner()` only after a name match, not for every extension on every invocation.

Refactor `IsOfficial` to take an Extension parameter instead of two strings, and call `ext.Owner()` only when the name matches.
